sbar.situation: The bank is recovered: two checks of the main payment journey, the last at 21 s, came back clean in a row. Payments is accepting transfers again and clearing is running.
sbar.background: A pipeline config change set payments max_transfer_minor from 1000000 to 1, so payments rejected nearly every payment with 422 'amount exceeds transfer limit' and screening got no traffic. Separately, the clearing worker crashed on malformed queue item 85 with a JSONDecodeError and exited with code 1, so its backlog grew.
sbar.assessment: The incident commander reverted payments max_transfer_minor from 1 back to 1000000, which ended the 422 rejections. It also quarantined clearing item 85 and restarted the clearing worker, which is now processing its backlog.
sbar.recommendation: The operations team has been asked (priority: soon) to review clearing item 85. They should repair and resubmit it, or close it with its customer, since that payment has not cleared. Find out why the pipeline set max_transfer_minor to 1 before it deploys again, and check which payments were rejected while the limit was wrong.
